IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Ericksen, Linville, Newhouse, Buri, Strow and B. Sullivan

Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing the highway weight limit for the movement of certain farm implements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the highway weight limit for farm implements;and amending RCW 46.44.130.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.44.130 and 1979 ex.s. c 136 s 76 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The limitations of RCW 46.44.010, 46.44.020, 46.44.030, and46.44.041 shall not apply to the movement of farm implements of lessthan one hundred sixty thousand pounds gross weight for farm implementstransporting dairy nutrients that comply with the provisions of chapter90.64 RCW or fortyfive thousand pounds gross weight for all other farmimplements, a total length of seventy feet or less, and a total outsidewidth of fourteen feet or less when being moved while patrolled,flagged, lighted, signed, and at a time of day in accordance with ruleshereby authorized to be adopted by the department of transportation andthe statutes. Violation of a rule adopted by the department asauthorized by this section or a term of this section is a trafficinfraction.
